# Hosts the agent CLIs and build tools reach at RUN TIME (login, inference, model
# catalogues, dependency resolution), as opposed to the installer hosts in
# workspace/agent/testdata/installer-egress-hosts.txt (storage.googleapis.com is a "!" line
# in both; keep the two in step). On an enforcing egress gateway a host missing from
# defaultEgressAllowlist breaks that kind with nothing pointing at the cause.
#
# Read by egress_runtime_hosts_test.go (control-plane): defaultEgressAllowlist admits every
# plain line, admits no "!" or "-" line, no host appears twice, and every destination tag
# exists in internal/agentroutes/catalog.json.
#
# Format, whitespace separated:   [!|-]host  kinds  destination  evidence   # source
#   kinds        comma-separated agent kinds (catalog.json "kinds"), or "build" for build tools
#   destination  a catalog.json destination id: the tag ADR 0138 M4 (#4171) uses to drop the
#                host of an excluded destination; "-" = never dropped
#   evidence     measured: seen on a production gateway in log-only (#4392)
#                docs: from vendor docs or the repo's own sources, never observed here
# "!" = needed but deliberately left to the admin (a general-purpose upload endpoint).
# "-" = looked at and left out: telemetry or cosmetic traffic the CLI does not need.
#
# Scope: the vendors' own endpoints only. BYOK routes (openrouter, sakana, gemini, vertex,
# custom APIs) and Bedrock (.amazonaws.com, already a default) are not listed here; the
# admin adds those hosts.
#
# Hosts are exact. A vendor-wide suffix (.googleapis.com) would admit storage.googleapis.com
# (.google.com would not, but opens every Google service). The one suffix in the defaults is
# .claude.com, beside .claude.ai and .anthropic.com; for M4, excluding anthropic drops it too.

# Claude Code (the three measured hosts are covered by the default suffix .claude.com)
platform.claude.com        claude    anthropic   measured
claude.com                 claude    anthropic   measured
code.claude.com            claude    anthropic   measured

# codex
chatgpt.com                codex     openai      measured
auth.openai.com            codex     openai      docs       # workspace/console CodexCard.dom.test.tsx:61; OpenAI community docs
api.openai.com             codex,opencode openai docs       # workspace/agent/internal/agents/codex/auth.go:126 (openai-api route)

# agy (Antigravity): backend and Google sign-in
daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com agy google     measured
cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com agy      google      docs       # Antigravity enterprise network doc (non-daily channel)
# accounts.google.com and oauth2.googleapis.com are shared with gcloud login
# (workspace/agent/internal/gcpx/login_agent.go:60) and Google SDK token refresh (ADR 0107):
# excluding google in M4 breaks those too.
accounts.google.com        agy       google      measured
oauth2.googleapis.com      agy       google      measured
# www.googleapis.com also serves the GCS upload API (/upload/storage/v1/...), measured live:
# admitting it would defeat the storage.googleapis.com exclusion, so it is the admin's.
!www.googleapis.com        agy       google      measured   # agy sign-in userinfo; add it when agy is used (#4398)
# agy side traffic, left out: the sign-in page renders in the member's own browser, not in
# the CLI, so static assets and the avatar are not needed; play.googleapis.com is
# telemetry and antigravity-unleash.goog is feature flags, which a CLI fails open on.
# Unmeasured either way: if enforce shows agy needing one, move it up with evidence.
-www.gstatic.com           agy       google      measured
-lh3.googleusercontent.com agy       google      measured
-play.googleapis.com       agy       google      measured
-antigravity-unleash.goog  agy       google      measured
!storage.googleapis.com    agy       google      docs       # agy install/update (also in the installer ledger); admin adds it

# opencode
models.dev                 opencode  -           measured   # opencode's catalogue AND the Agent's daily price table for every kind (workspace/agent model_catalog_fetch.go:9)
models.opencode.ai         opencode  opencode.ai measured
opencode.ai                opencode  opencode.ai docs       # zen route: agents/opencode/errors.go:18
console.opencode.ai        opencode  opencode.ai docs       # account device login and /api/orgs: agents/opencode/oauth_test.go:60, docs/log/54 §54.7

# Build tools (no agent kind, no destination)
plugins.gradle.org         build     -           measured
repo.maven.apache.org      build     -           measured
services.gradle.org        build     -           docs       # Gradle wrapper download: tool_caches_gradle_test.go:13

api.business.githubcopilot.com copilot github    docs       # same; Business plan
api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com copilot github  docs       # same; Enterprise plan

# 2026-11-30; its CLI doc also names *.cursorapi.com. Re-check these after the move (#4398).
api2.cursor.sh             cursor    cursor      docs       # cursor.com enterprise network configuration

authenticate.cursor.sh     cursor    cursor      docs       # same

prod.us-east-1.auth.desktop.kiro.dev kiro kiro    docs      # same

# Legacy inference host, already inside the default suffix .amazonaws.com, so M4 cannot
# drop it by destination.
